critical_code_review_comments: TradeHistoryTable only shows TradeTicket inside the exit-audit Tooltip (line 126) — badges are invisible until the user hovers the search icon. ActiveTradesTable renders it inline. Consider surfacing the book badge on the row for parity.

doctor_learning.status() returns empty books dict until first cycle() runs (self.last seeded with books:{}). Fresh backend after restart therefore returns books:{} — a cold-start defence (auto-warm on first status call, or gate the UI on a 'ready' flag) would avoid flaky UI/tests. Worked around in tests by POST /api/doctor/run-now first.
